title: 顾客找商品太慢，怎样介绍体验改进？
topic: 用搜索时间和转化率说明购物体验改进的业务价值

source.title: Central Group case study
source.type: Google Cloud 官方客户业务案例
source.context: Google Cloud 官方 Central Group 客户案例：线上导购与商品搜索改进。
paragraphs: Central Retail Group, a subsidiary of Central Group, operates Tops supermarket, the largest supermarket chain in Thailand. A fleet of personal shoppers assists online customers in selecting and purchasing their grocery items. Initially launched through Tops Thailand LINE official account on [October 9, 2024], Chefbot streamlines the sales process by generating shoppable recipes based on customer preferences. Leveraging external data, the gen AI chatbot, powered by Gemini, maps recipe ingredients to over 50,000 Tops-specific product stock-keeping units (SKUs), creating a shopping list for the personal shopper. By automating the customer order process, personal shoppers can save valuable time per order and focus on cross-selling and upselling complementary products.

At the same time, Central Group improves the personal shopping experience for its department store customers by introducing AI-driven visual search. Powered by Vertex AI Search for retail, the tool analyzes and recognizes images uploaded by customers and matches them to relevant products in the product catalog. The real-time results are shared with personal shoppers so they can help customers buy the right products.

This helps to reduce the searching time for items under the price/promotion/stock categories from 32 minutes to between one to two minutes, a 94% reduction. In addition, conversion rate has been uplifted by 10% with the help of the tool.
translations: Central Retail Group 是 Central Group 的子公司，运营泰国最大的连锁超市 Tops。线上顾客可以由私人购物顾问协助挑选和购买食品杂货。Chefbot 最初于 2024 年 10 月 9 日通过 Tops Thailand 官方 LINE 账号上线，它会根据顾客偏好生成可直接购买食材的菜谱。这个由 Gemini 驱动的聊天机器人结合外部数据，把菜谱食材映射到 Tops 的 5 万多种商品，生成购物清单。自动化订单流程后，私人购物顾问每单能节省时间，并能把精力放在交叉销售和追加销售上。
Central Group 还通过 AI 视觉搜索改善百货商店顾客的购物体验。该功能由 Vertex AI Search for retail 提供支持，可以识别顾客上传的图片，并从商品目录中匹配相关商品。搜索结果会实时提供给私人购物顾问，帮助他们为顾客找到合适的商品。
这项功能把顾客按价格、促销或库存搜索商品的时间，从 32 分钟缩短到 1 至 2 分钟，减少了 94%。此外，转化率提高了 10%。
fullTextParagraphs: Reduces personal shopper order completion time with Gemini-powered Chefbot and creates consistent product descriptions up to 50% faster using Vertex AI's large language models
Enhances search capabilities with visual search with Vertex AI Search to help customers find products more easily
Personal shoppers reduce search time for 'price/promotion/stock' categories by 94%, with a conversion rate uplift of 10%

Reduces deployment time from six to two months with Gemini Flash to rapidly introduce new AI use cases and delivers timely sentiment analysis response to business units with self-service customer insight chatbot powered by Gemini that analyzes more than one million customer feedback annually to drive improvements

Accelerates AI transformation across the organization with AI Circle of Excellence, AI Squad for best practices and knowledge sharing, and AI Academy for fostering AI awareness through classes and workshops
Central Retail Group employs Google Cloud AI and machine learning solutions to automate tasks, thus improving customer experiences and potentially sales, while maintaining a personalized touch.

AI is revolutionizing the retail industry, enabling us to work smarter and deliver personalized customer experiences. While AI is a valuable tool, it cannot fully replace the human touch. Leveraging Google Gemini for our personal shopper chatbot, we're able to automate tasks such as the shopping list, improving customer experiences and potentially sales, while maintaining a personalized touch.
Senior Vice President and Head of Digital Office, Central Group

Central Retail Group, a subsidiary of Central Group, operates Tops supermarket, the largest supermarket chain in Thailand. A fleet of personal shoppers assists online customers in selecting and purchasing their grocery items. Initially launched through Tops Thailand LINE official account on [October 9, 2024], Chefbot streamlines the sales process by generating shoppable recipes based on customer preferences. Leveraging external data, the gen AI chatbot, powered by Gemini, maps recipe ingredients to over 50,000 Tops-specific product stock-keeping units (SKUs), creating a shopping list for the personal shopper. By automating the customer order process, personal shoppers can save valuable time per order and focus on cross-selling and upselling complementary products.

Merchandisers previously spent hours writing product descriptions in English and Thai for 400 new products daily, adhering to Central Retail's strict content guidelines. The team now utilizes an AI-powered catalog enrichment tool to generate product descriptions, significantly reducing time and ensuring consistency. The tool leverages pre-trained large language models (LLMs) with Vertex AI to extract product attributes like name, brand, and price from existing descriptions. These SEO-optimized product descriptions enhance product discoverability on the department store website by incorporating relevant keywords. Central Retail is currently exploring Vertex AI Vision to extract visual context from product images, further enriching product data.

At the same time, Central Group improves the personal shopping experience for its department store customers by introducing AI-driven visual search. Powered by Vertex AI Search for retail, the tool analyzes and recognizes images uploaded by customers and matches them to relevant products in the product catalog. The real-time results are shared with personal shoppers so they can help customers buy the right products.

This helps to reduce the searching time for items under the price/promotion/stock categories from 32 minutes to between one to two minutes, a 94% reduction. In addition, conversion rate has been uplifted by 10% with the help of the tool.

Central Retail Corporation Public Company Limited ("the Company" or "Central Retail") is the leading multi-format and multi-category retailing platform in Thailand. Central Retail is also growing internationally, securing leadership status in Italy, and becoming one of the leaders in Vietnam.
Products: Gemini, Vertex AI, Vertex AI Search

scenario.title: 顾客找价格、促销和库存信息要花很久
english: Online shoppers need help finding products by price, promotion, and stock.
Central Group introduced visual search and shared results with personal shoppers.
Report how search time and conversion changed.
chinese: 线上顾客需要按价格、促销和库存情况寻找商品。
Central Group 引入视觉搜索，并把结果提供给购物顾问。
请汇报搜索时间和转化率的变化。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请向零售业务负责人介绍 Central Group 的线上购物改进：说明顾客遇到的问题、视觉搜索如何帮助购物顾问，以及搜索时间和转化率的变化。
firstAttempt.sample: Customers spent 32 minutes searching for products by price, promotion, or stock. Central Group introduced visual search to help personal shoppers find relevant products from customer images. Search time fell from 32 minutes to one or two minutes. Conversion increased by 10%.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把搜索耗时和转化率放在一起，既说明顾客体验，也说明业务变化。
